name: FDC Consolidated Holdings Limited
summary: FDC Consolidated Holdings Limited provides construction, fitout, and refurbishment services in Australia. The company engages in the construction of new-build and redevelopment projects; interior fitout; and re-use and heritage projects. It also offers building services. The company caters various sectors, including industrial and manufacturing, logistics, commercial, data centres, education, government, accommodation, and community infrastructure projects. FDC Consolidated Holdings Limited was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
